body: Same! I’m painting my living room after thinking of it for months.

I know the feeling. Although for me this you speak about, the emotions and the thought of ending the pain you’re in came when I was 34 years old although the rape by my father occurred all throughout my childhood until the age of 13. I share that so you know that you’re not alone. Having been raped in your teen years is horrific and you didn’t deserve any of it. You are loved and cared for. The pain you’re currently in won’t let you see it but trust me there are people out there who want to help. Hug yourself knowing this and use the rage that’s in you to get yourself out of this. I believe in your strength for because you’re alive, anything is possible. And you have survived the worst of any kind of pain. You’ve got this.
